datasets.name: market_price_trends
queryLines:
SELECT 
  market,
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp_utc) as hour,
  AVG(price_usd) as avg_price,
  MIN(price_usd) as min_price,
  MAX(price_usd) as max_price,
  SUM(volume) as total_volume,
  COUNT(*) as trade_count,
  currency
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.silver_unified_markets
WHERE timestamp_utc >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 7)
GROUP BY market, DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp_utc), currency
ORDER BY hour DESC, market

datasets.name: arbitrage_opportunities
queryLines:
SELECT 
  market_buy,
  market_sell,
  timestamp,
  spread,
  confidence_score,
  volume_potential,
  profit_potential,
  opportunity_score,
  roi_percentage,
  execution_priority,
  market_conditions
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.silver_arbitrage_opportunities
WHERE opportunity_score >= :min_opportunity_score
  AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 1)
ORDER BY opportunity_score DESC, timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: trading_hub_performance
queryLines:
SELECT 
  hub,
  trading_date,
  total_communications,
  urgent_communications,
  total_profit_potential,
  avg_opportunity_score,
  unique_arbitrage_pairs,
  communication_efficiency,
  profit_per_communication,
  CASE 
    WHEN avg_opportunity_score > 0.7 THEN 'High Performance'
    WHEN avg_opportunity_score > 0.5 THEN 'Medium Performance'
    ELSE 'Low Performance'
  END as performance_category
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.gold_trading_hub_performance
WHERE trading_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30)
ORDER BY trading_date DESC, avg_opportunity_score DESC

datasets.name: news_sentiment_analysis
queryLines:
SELECT 
  geographic_region,
  market_mentioned,
  trading_hub,
  avg_sentiment,
  avg_relevance,
  avg_news_score,
  article_count,
  breaking_news_count,
  high_impact_count,
  positive_articles,
  negative_articles,
  neutral_articles,
  sentiment_ratio,
  last_updated,
  CASE 
    WHEN sentiment_ratio > 0.2 THEN 'Bullish Sentiment'
    WHEN sentiment_ratio < -0.2 THEN 'Bearish Sentiment'
    ELSE 'Neutral Sentiment'
  END as market_sentiment
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.silver_news_sentiment_by_region
ORDER BY last_updated DESC, avg_news_score DESC

datasets.name: risk_positions
queryLines:
SELECT 
  trading_hub,
  market,
  trader_id,
  position_size_mwh,
  entry_price_usd,
  current_price_usd,
  unrealized_pnl_usd,
  position_type,
  risk_level,
  strategy,
  expiry_date,
  margin_requirement,
  timestamp,
  CASE 
    WHEN unrealized_pnl_usd > 1000 THEN 'Profitable'
    WHEN unrealized_pnl_usd < -1000 THEN 'At Risk'
    ELSE 'Neutral'
  END as pnl_status,
  ABS(position_size_mwh) * current_price_usd as position_value_usd
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.bronze_trading_positions
WHERE timestamp >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 7)
  AND risk_level = :risk_level_filter
ORDER BY ABS(unrealized_pnl_usd) DESC

datasets.name: cross_market_analytics
queryLines:
SELECT 
  market,
  hour,
  avg_price_usd,
  min_price_usd,
  max_price_usd,
  data_points,
  price_range,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hour ORDER BY avg_price_usd DESC) as price_rank
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.gold_hourly_market_summary
WHERE hour >= DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()), 3)
ORDER BY hour DESC, avg_price_usd DESC

datasets.name: real_time_alerts
queryLines:
SELECT 
  hour,
  total_intel_messages,
  avg_intelligence_score,
  bullish_signals,
  bearish_signals,
  coordination_required,
  markets_mentioned,
  SIZE(active_hubs) as active_hub_count,
  market_sentiment,
  CASE 
    WHEN total_intel_messages > 10 THEN 'High Alert'
    WHEN total_intel_messages > 5 THEN 'Medium Alert'
    ELSE 'Normal'
  END as alert_level,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() as dashboard_refresh_time
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.gold_market_intelligence_summary
WHERE hour >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 1)
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 24

datasets.name: arbitrage_dashboard_summary
queryLines:
SELECT 
  market_buy,
  market_sell,
  hour,
  opportunity_count,
  avg_confidence,
  total_profit_potential,
  avg_spread,
  avg_opportunity_score,
  market_pair,
  profitability_rank,
  CASE 
    WHEN avg_confidence > 0.8 THEN 'Highly Confident'
    WHEN avg_confidence > 0.6 THEN 'Moderately Confident'
    ELSE 'Low Confidence'
  END as confidence_level
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.gold_arbitrage_dashboard
WHERE hour >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 2)
ORDER BY hour DESC, avg_opportunity_score DESC

datasets.name: breaking_news_impact
queryLines:
WITH news_price_correlation AS (
  SELECT 
    n.published_date,
    n.content,
    n.source,
    n.market_mentioned,
    n.geographic_region,
    n.sentiment_score,
    n.relevance_score,
    n.market_impact,
    n.breaking_news,
    m.market,
    m.price_usd as market_price,
    m.timestamp_utc as price_timestamp,
    ABS(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, n.published_date, m.timestamp_utc)) as time_diff_minutes
  FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.bronze_news_articles n
  JOIN totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.silver_unified_markets m 
    ON n.market_mentioned = m.market
    AND ABS(DATEDIFF(HOUR, n.published_date, m.timestamp_utc)) <= 2
  WHERE  n.published_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 7)
)
SELECT 
  published_date,
  content,
  source,
  market_mentioned,
  geographic_region,
  ROUND(sentiment_score, 3) as sentiment_score,
  ROUND(relevance_score, 3) as relevance_score,
  market_impact,
  ROUND(market_price, 2) as market_price_usd,
  time_diff_minutes,
  CASE 
    WHEN sentiment_score > 0 AND market_price > LAG(market_price) OVER (PARTITION BY market_mentioned ORDER BY published_date) THEN 'Positive Correlation'
    WHEN sentiment_score < -0.2 AND market_price < LAG(market_price) OVER (PARTITION BY market_mentioned ORDER BY published_date) THEN 'Negative Correlation'
    ELSE 'No Clear Correlation'
  END as price_sentiment_correlation
FROM news_price_correlation
ORDER BY published_date DESC, relevance_score DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: news_sentiment_trends
queryLines:
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', published_date) as news_hour,
  market_mentioned,
  geographic_region,
  source,
  COUNT(*) as article_count,
  AVG(sentiment_score) as avg_sentiment,
  AVG(relevance_score) as avg_relevance,
  SUM(CASE WHEN breaking_news = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as breaking_news_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN market_impact = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_impact_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment_score > 0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_articles,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment_score < -0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative_articles,
  CASE 
    WHEN AVG(sentiment_score) > 0.3 THEN 'Very Bullish'
    WHEN AVG(sentiment_score) > 0.1 THEN 'Bullish'
    WHEN AVG(sentiment_score) > -0.1 THEN 'Neutral'
    WHEN AVG(sentiment_score) > -0.3 THEN 'Bearish'
    ELSE 'Very Bearish'
  END as hourly_sentiment_trend
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.bronze_news_articles
WHERE published_date >= DATEADD(HOUR, -CAST(:time_window_hours AS INT), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', published_date), market_mentioned, geographic_region, source
ORDER BY news_hour DESC, avg_sentiment DESC

datasets.name: real_time_news_alerts
queryLines:
SELECT 
  published_date,
  content,
  source,
  market_mentioned,
  geographic_region,
  trading_hub,
  sentiment_score,
  relevance_score,
  market_impact,
  breaking_news,
  keywords,
  CASE 
    WHEN breaking_news = true AND market_impact = 'high' AND ABS(sentiment_score) > 0.3 THEN '🚨 CRITICAL ALERT'
    WHEN breaking_news = true AND market_impact = 'high' THEN '⚠️ HIGH PRIORITY'
    WHEN market_impact = 'high' AND ABS(sentiment_score) > 0.2 THEN '📢 MEDIUM PRIORITY'
    WHEN breaking_news = true THEN '📰 BREAKING NEWS'
    ELSE '📝 STANDARD'
  END as alert_level,
  CASE 
    WHEN published_date >= DATEADD(HOUR, -1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) THEN '🔴 Last Hour'
    WHEN published_date >= DATEADD(HOUR, -6, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) THEN '🟡 Last 6 Hours'
    WHEN published_date >= DATEADD(HOUR, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) THEN '🟢 Last 24 Hours'
    ELSE '⚪ Older'
  END as recency,
  DATEDIFF(MINUTE, published_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) as minutes_ago,
  ROUND(sentiment_score * relevance_score * CASE WHEN market_impact = 'high' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END, 3) as impact_score
FROM totalenergies.energy_market_intelligence.bronze_news_articles
WHERE published_date >= DATEADD(HOUR, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  AND (breaking_news = true OR market_impact = 'high' OR ABS(sentiment_score) > :min_sentiment_threshold)
ORDER BY impact_score DESC, published_date DESC
LIMIT 100
